title: Signal: Contract destruction call present in solidity — review required
scope: Single-line match on contract destruction in solidity.
limitations: Lexical: matches selfdestruct and suicide calls; the guard condition is not evaluated.

examples.line: # audit: function close() public onlyOwner { selfdestruct(payable(owner)); } present
function close() public onlyOwner { paused = true; }
# verified: function close() public onlyOwner { paused = true; }

fpNotes: A deliberately ephemeral factory that the design documents as destroyable is the accepted exception.
